purpose: Teach: お誘い/腕時計/立ち寄っ/ふく/うわさ/閉じる/スリム/じゅう

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達のお誘い、断っちゃダメかな、行きたくないの。
lines.en: Mom… can I say no to a friend's invitation? I don't really want to go.
lines.style: Quiet, hesitant opening. Small voice checking if it's okay to disappoint. Soft trailing-off on the confession. Eyes down, waiting for permission to not be perfect.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さんの腕時計、新しいの、買ったのよ、お誕生日に。
lines.en: Your dad got a new watch for his birthday. I bought it for him.
lines.style: Warm, steady tone. Gentle pivot—she heard him but is answering a different question. Practical warmth, the kind that loves by redirecting. No judgment in the subject change.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 帰り道、お祖父ちゃんち、立ち寄ってきたよ、ぼく、お話、いっぱいした。
lines.en: On the way home, I stopped by Grandpa's house. We talked for a really long time.
lines.style: Brightening noticeably. Alive with the memory. Words come a little faster. Pride in having spent time with Grandpa. Small boy genuinely pleased with himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お顔の汗、ハンカチで、ふくようにね、翔くん。
lines.en: Wipe the sweat off your face with your handkerchief, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, everyday direction—not a correction. Gentle hand reaching. Voice of someone tending to small, necessary things. The rhythm of after-school care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 学校で、ぼくの、変なうわさ、流れてるんだよ、嫌だな。
lines.en: There's a weird rumor going around about me at school. I don't like it.
lines.style: Voice tightens on 'weird rumor.' Vulnerable complaint—the part he's been holding. Quieter on 'don't like it,' almost ashamed to admit it matters. Seeking reassurance, not sure he'll get it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう寝る時間ね、本、閉じる前に、お話しようね、翔くん。
lines.en: It's time for bed now. Let's talk before you close your book, Sho.
lines.style: Tender, bedtime-voice. Knowing he needs something—not pushing, but opening the door. Unhurried. The invitation underneath the direction. Calm and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、運動会、スリムに走れるようになりたいな、お父さんみたいに。
lines.en: I want to run fast at sports day, like Dad does.
lines.style: Hopeful, earnest. Voice brightens at the image of his father. Eager without being manic—genuine ambition. Small-boy admiration. Opening with fresh energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日は、一日じゅう、お祭りの準備、頑張ったわね、翔くん。
lines.en: You worked hard all day on the festival preparations, Sho.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Close, genuine praise. Not overdone, but specific and real. The tone of a mother noticing effort without needing to fix anything. Steady eye contact in her voice.
